definitions.gloss: regional revitalization; community development; local revitalization
definitions.explanation: Efforts to revive or develop declining rural or local communities through economic, cultural, or social initiatives. A major policy topic in Japan due to rural depopulation.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}おこし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
{地域|ちいき}おこし{協力隊|きょうりょくたい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{移住|いじゅう}した→移住する：17190_ijuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I moved there as a member of the regional revitalization cooperation corps.

examples.japanese: ⟦{特産品|とくさんひん}→特産品：13483_tokusanhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かした→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧{地域|ちいき}おこし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Regional revitalization efforts that leverage local specialty products are spreading nationwide.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ (region, area) + おこし (raising up, reviving — from ⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧). A key concept in contemporary Japanese society, where many rural areas face severe population decline (⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地域|ちいき}おこし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to work on regional revitalization
- {地域|ちいき}おこし{協力隊|きょうりょくたい}: regional revitalization cooperation corps (a government program)
- {地域|ちいき}おこし⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧: community revitalization event

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {地域|ちいき}おこし{協力隊|きょうりょくたい} is a Japanese government program established in 2009 that sends urban residents to rural areas for 1-3 years to help with local development. Participants often engage in tourism promotion, agriculture, and community building.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{町|まち}おこし→町おこし：13570_machiokoshi⟧: town revitalization — same concept at the town level
- ⟦{村|むら}おこし→村おこし：21175_muraokoshi⟧: village revitalization — same concept at the village level
- ⟦{地方創生|ちほうそうせい}→地方創生：20989_chihousousei⟧: regional revitalization — the formal government policy term
